claim.text: One small AGENTS.md pointing at files that already hold the rules; hub+pointer is the dominant cross-tool pattern.
AGENTS.md capped at N lines: small context files cut agent runtime/tokens; past ~150-200 instructions rules get ignored, not obeyed.
Stale docs poison agents that re-read them every request; enforce size and pointer integrity, do not trust prose.
TODO items are hypotheses whose confidence decays when untouched: LLMs escalate commitment under prior-investment framing; written plans discharge open-loop load (human side).
Ship few verbs; deep mechanisms (skills/hooks/subagents) see shallow real adoption, add executable depth only after a customer earns it.
Tamper-visibility beats tamper-resistance: hand edits are legal, but unsigned drift is loud via the hash chain.
